professionalCapabilities.workProduct: Evidence-backed prospect qualification and prioritization decision
evidenceStandards: confidence level and missing evidence recorded
no invented revenue or demand claims

acceptanceCriteria: qualification is evidence-backed and decision-useful
commercial reasoning is proportionate to available evidence
high-value or low-confidence cases remain human-reviewable
output meets strong professional market-research standard

professionalCapabilities.workProduct: Professionally grounded website/business diagnosis and suitable offer recommendation
evidenceStandards: visible issue inventory with source references
impact hypotheses clearly labeled as hypotheses
recommended intervention tied to observed problem
offer/package fit with assumptions and exclusions

acceptanceCriteria: diagnosis distinguishes symptom, cause hypothesis, and intervention
offer is neither under-scoped nor inflated beyond evidence
website brief is coherent enough for professional production
output meets strong consultant/strategist standard

professionalCapabilities.workProduct: Evidence-grounded outreach and versioned commercial proposal
evidenceStandards: specific observed issue referenced without overclaiming
scope, price/package source, assumptions, exclusions and acceptance path versioned

acceptanceCriteria: message is specific rather than templated/generic
claims are supportable from evidence
proposal is commercially coherent and understandable
tone and CTA fit the prospect context
output meets strong professional copy/sales standard

professionalCapabilities.workProduct: Production-grade customer website or website improvement package
evidenceStandards: approved production brief and traceable scope
Run 015 design/UX evidence where UI is material

acceptanceCriteria: Run 015 professional excellence criteria pass for material UI
Run 014 professional engineering criteria pass
website satisfies approved commercial brief without scope drift
no critical accessibility/security/functionality blocker
customer-facing output meets strong professional agency standard

professionalCapabilities.workProduct: Controlled delivery, acceptance, issue routing, and follow-up package
evidenceStandards: acceptance criteria and known limitations surfaced
follow-up/expansion recommendation does not alter price/scope without approval

acceptanceCriteria: handoff is clear and low-friction for customer
issues are routed with ownership and next action
follow-up is useful rather than spammy
commercial adjustments remain approval-gated
output meets strong professional customer-success standard

revalidationRule: Design PASS is necessary but not sufficient. G4 requires at least 10 real shadow cases compared with human professional judgments across qualification, diagnosis, outreach/proposal and production; production claims also require current Run 014 and Run 015 evidence.
